title: Canopy CO2 Enrichment Dynamics (1200 ppm) and Rubisco Carboxylation Kinetics under Variable PPFD Regimes
author: Dr. vmffkxhs2362
abstract: Ambient $CO_2$ (415 ppm) limits Rubisco carboxylation efficiency in high-density CEA greenhouses. We modeled Rubisco oxygenase vs carboxylase activity across $CO_2$ enrichment levels from 400 to 1500 ppm under PPFD levels up to 400 μmol/m²/s. Enriching canopy air to 1200 ppm suppressed photorespiration by 68%, boosting net assimilation rate ($A_{net}$) by 38.5% and reducing water loss.
key_findings: Enriching $CO_2$ to 1200 ppm increased Rubisco carboxylation velocity ($V_{cmax}$) from 68 to 112 μmol/m²/s.
Photorespiratory ammonium release was suppressed by 68%, improving nitrogen use efficiency.
Crop harvest cycle was accelerated by 5.5 days across leafy green species.
